## W05 Risk and degree of autonomy

W05   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: task risk tier, operating tier and legal classification are each recorded with reasons; every material scenario has a W05A; and the hard-stop conditions name a risk acceptance authority.

Source basis: [Slow AI Kitchen](https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen) · [GRC Workbook](https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) · [AI Impact Assessment Tool](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-Impact-Assessment-Tool)

Record three separate classifications: Kitchen task risk, GRC Workbook operating tier and applicable legal classification. They are not interchangeable.

| **Kitchen task risk** | **Minimum depth** |
| --- | --- |
| 1 Low stakes | 1 to 3 tests; light human first pass; quick context scan; bounded use, owner and basic review. Verify before external use. Service Record optional. |
| 2 Moderate stakes | 3 to 7 tests; full first-pass form; documented context; named reviewer and owner; evidence log and sign-off. Service Record recommended. |
| 3 High stakes | Full recorded method; distinct Reviewer, Approver and Owner; second review; escalation; sign-off and remediation or rollback plan. Service Record required. |

Tiering deepens gates; it never removes them. Legal, compliance or consequential determinations do not become moderate stakes merely because the output is labeled a draft.

GRC operating scale: 0 observation; 1 drafting with human review; 2 recommendations with human decision; 3 execution with human-on-the-loop; 4 execution with periodic human audit; 5 bounded autonomous operation.
